Grandma's Tomato Soup

This is the soup I grew up with. It takes about 35 minutes and serves 4.

Ingredients

  • 2 tbsp butter
  • 1 onion, diced
  • 2 cloves garlic, minced
  • 800 g canned tomatoes
  • 500 ml vegetable broth
  • 100 ml cream
  • Salt and pepper

Instructions

  1. Melt the butter in a pot and cook the onion until tender.
  2. Add the garlic and stir for one minute.
  3. Add tomatoes and broth, bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes.
  4. Blend until smooth, stir in the cream and season with salt and pepper.
